newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit stays rangebound on lack of factors.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit stays rangebound on lack of factors.

text.p: The ringgit was rangebound in late Asian trading for lack of any fresh trading factors, dealers said on Monday.
They said there was little activity in the afternoon after the minor transactions in the morning, which were mainly for corporate customers.
"Dollar/ringgit is very very quiet today because there is no factor to trade on," said a U.S bank dealer in Singapore.
He said the market still favoured the ringgit though in the near-term a strong dollar was keeping it subdued.
"There was some (dollar) selling interest around 2.4770 level, but around 2.4760 some commercial demand from KL stopped the movement," said the head of dealing at a Malaysian bank.
He said activity was mainly driven by commercial demand and interbank players were quiet.
There was also little activity in ringgit/Singapore dollar, though some profit-taking was expected soon, dealers said.
"The ringgit is still looking to strengthen in the medium and long-term," said a dealer with another Malaysian bank.
At 0930 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4769/74 a dollar.
